title: Evidence for renormalized instantons in real-time simulations of vacuum decay
summary: While vacuum decay is traditionally described by Euclidean instanton methods, lattice simulations enable real-time modeling of dynamical observables relevant to cosmology and upcoming cold-atom analog experiments. We investigate the relationship between these approaches by extracting ensemble-averaged bubble profiles from zero-temperature simulations of a relativistic scalar field. Our observed profiles differ markedly from the bare Coleman bounce and classical thermal predictions.
